shortDescription: Manage DNS resolvers on a BIG-IP

options.name: answer_default_zones
options.description: Specifies whether the system answers DNS queries for the default zones localhost, reverse 127.0.0.1 and ::1, and AS112. When creating a new resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(false), meaning the system passes along the DNS queries for the default zones.

options.name: cache_size
options.description: Specifies the size of the internal DNS resolver cache. When creating a new resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is 5767168 bytes. After the cache reaches this size, when new or refreshed content arrives, the system removes expired and older content and caches the new or updated content.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the DNS resolver.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: randomize_query_case
options.description: When C(true), specifies the internal DNS resolver randomizes character case in domain name queries issued to the root DNS servers. When creating a new resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(true).

options.name: route_domain
options.description: Specifies the route domain the resolver uses for outbound traffic.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.

options.name: use_ipv4
options.description: Specifies whether the system can use IPv4 to query backend nameservers. An IPv4 Self IP and default route must be available for these queries to work successfully. When creating a new resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(true).

options.name: use_ipv6
options.description: Specifies whether the system can use IPv6 to query backend nameservers. An IPv6 Self IP and default route must be available for these queries to work successfully. When creating a new resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(true).

options.name: use_tcp
options.description: Specifies whether the system answers and issues TCP-formatted queries. When creating a new resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(true).

options.name: use_udp
options.description: Specifies whether the system answers and issues UDP-formatted queries. When creating a new resolver, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(true).
